content.short: Xapo Bank is a members only private bank for Bitcoin holders, with USD and BTC accounts, interest and a debit card.
content.description: Xapo has been storing Bitcoin for clients since 2013 and now operates as a licensed bank in Gibraltar under the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission. Members keep both USD and BTC accounts, earn interest on either, and can borrow against their Bitcoin rather than selling it, which suits long term holders who still need money to spend. Custody combines underground vaults with MPC technology and personal access controls. Membership also covers a debit card, transfers in major currencies, access to US stocks and ETFs, inheritance planning and a dedicated relationship manager.
